posts.title: The Importance Of Six Sigma Training
posts.bodyHtml:
Six Sigma is a methodology to get near perfect quality of product and services. It is based on data driven methods to eliminate the cause of defects and their origin. To attain a Six Sigma, any process must not exceed the limit of 3.4 DPMO (Defects per Million Opportunities). Anything which is not required or specified by the customer is referred to as a defect. The main objective of a Six Sigma method is to implement a measurement based approach which focuses to improve the process and reduction of defects. A Six Sigma methodology is based on two sub methodologies; first is DMAIC (Define, Measure, Analyse, Improve, Control) and the second is DMADV (Define, Measure, Analyse, Design, Improve). These sub methodologies help to introduce new and improve processes to get the required Six Sigma quality. Both the processes of Six Sigma are executed by Six Sigma black belt and green belt, overseen by the master black belt. But it is necessary to understand the methodology of six sigma before working on any project.

Benefits and need of s Six Sigma training:

Six Sigma training is essential to attain profound knowledge about Six Sigma methodologies. It defines the methodologies that help to provide an appropriate alignment to the business strategies. The training defines the roles and responsibilities of different entities working in an organisation. It focuses on proper planning and collection of useful information that helps to take an appropriate decision. The training enables the candidate to predict all possible defects and their consequences and hence effectively eliminates all the possible causes of defects. This results in a consistent, cost effective and error free product and services.

Various objectives of Lean Six Sigma training:

Lean Six Sigma training plays a crucial role in defining strategic business planning which helps to accomplish the task sequentially. This reduces the cause of defects as well as reduces the work cycle. Budget plan is also very essential cause for the success of the project because exceeding the desired cause effects the economic condition of an organisation. This training enables to estimate the cost and time required by a project which helps to deliver the demand before time and within the estimated cost.

Requirements of a Six Sigma certification in the industry:

A Six Sigma certification is an approval for the knowledge about Sigma strategies and its methodologies. Through this certification course, the candidate learns to prioritise the task in an appropriate sequence and by implementing sigma based strategies. The validity of the certificate is throughout the globe and it is offered through various organisations. The demand for a well qualified and professional certificate is high and thus it is necessary to have a Six Sigma certification.

posts.title: Success Of Six Sigma
posts.bodyHtml:
The success story of Six Sigma began with Motorola, the USA which launched these programmes for removing variation in manufactured electronic items. It was soon followed up by GE and Ford. In the first five years after the introduction of Six Sigma techniques, GE saved ten billion dollars. That is a lot of money which can find uses in some other projects of the organisation. Thus, Six Sigma Training is the most sought after and also available in many institutes. However, one with all the study material and trained faculty are The Knowledge Academy.

Six Sigma teams comprise all employees of the organisation thus their training in Six Sigma becomes a very expensive proposition. Also, a lot of thought goes into choosing a Six Sigma project. The evaluation of the need for a Six Sigma project is done by the top management. It has to convince itself that there is a need for improvement in service or there is a need to remove a defect recurring in the product. Once that is done a charter defining the defect and the affirmation that it needs to be eradicated from the roots is signed by the top management. Six Sigma project champion then forms various Six Sigma teams to get down to the job of removing the defect totally and give a near zero-defect yield. This is the essence of Six Sigma methodology. The top rank of project champion can be achieved by doing Six Sigma Certification.

Six Sigma Training also covers the statistical part of it. It trains one to handle data so that one can mathematically work out the Sigma value of a manufacturing process for a particular product. Statistically, sigma is a measure of the dispersion from the mean. If you specify the mean quality standard of a product and then define the upper and lower limits of acceptance then all manufactured items must lie around the mean value and not exceed the set limits. This curve is drawn looks like a bell. When you spread this curve to six times sigma on either side of the mean you have on ground achieved near zero-defect yield. It means only 3.4 defects per billion opportunities.

The Six Sigma technique deploys the application of a tool called DMAIC. It means that if one proceeds step by step following the DMAIC one would achieve success. D stands for define- it means we must first define the defect. What is it that has caused customer dissatisfaction? The feedback received from the customers or by one to one contact with them gives enough data to arrive at an answer. Thereafter, the Six Sigma teams get down to measuring (M) it. It means finding out what is causing the defect to occur. Once, the reason for the defect is known the process of analysis (A) starts. All possible solutions to the problem are studied and then the best one is chosen for implementation (I). The implemented solution is then controlled (C) for a certain period of time and its effectiveness is monitored until it is placed as a substitute technology permanently. A Six Sigma Certification is worth acquiring to be a much sought after quality management professional.

posts.title: Brands Sell With Lean Six Sigma
posts.bodyHtml:
It is the responsibility of the top management to create a high quality environment in an organisation by being willing to undertake Six Sigma projects. The management cannot afford to pick these projects on hearsay or randomly. It has to be doubly sure that there is no alternative but Six Sigma to remove a persistently reported defect. The Six Sigma is the most effective, efficient and agile data driven methodology for achieving near perfect quality.

Management professionals all over the world in fields as diverse as hospitals to local bodies to defence and banking are adopting the Six Sigma techniques to achieve a very high quality yield. The feat is achieved with the help of statistical tools as well as logical check valve of DMAIC. Six Sigma Certification will educate on these two important aspects of Six Sigma. A word about the two will not be out of place.

In a manufacturing process the quality specifications are first specified. The mean value of these is calculated and then a standard deviation curve is drawn. It is a bell shaped curve. Its peak is the standard mean and its limits are the extreme values within which the quality of the item manufactured must lie. Those items found to exceed the limits are called defects. The number of places that a defect has probability of occurring is called opportunity. To reduce these defects to almost zero (3.4 in a sample population of million opportunities) is the objective of Six Sigma. This is the statistical model of Six Sigma. On ground it means that the process of Standard deviation is stretched to such an extent (12 Sigma span or 6 sigma on either side of the mean) which makes defect occurrence a non-event. This statistical concept will be explained in detail in the Six Sigma Course.

As far as DMAIC check is concerned it is the most logical approach towards implementing and executing Six Sigma procedures. The Six Sigma teams “Define” the defect. That means to be sure that a defect does exist. Once that has been done it is “Measured”- to find the amount of deviation from the specifications of quality. Then it is “Analysed” to know the why and how of it. The best amongst the available solutions to remove the defects is identified. These are then “Implemented” and the new processes are “Controlled” till they prove to be effective. Six Sigma teams follow DMAIC tool to the hilt to ensure the success of a Six Sigma project. The same are projected in Six Sigma Training.

Noticeably, Six Sigma is not only a metric or a methodology to improve business processes and meet the demands of customers but it is also a complete management system by itself since it links the above two with the business strategy of the organisation. In fact it is a brand that sells. Learn all about it in Six Sigma Certification.

The quality specifications based on inputs received from customers are laid down and their extreme limits are also defined (Normal curve). All products which lie between these extremes pass the quality control test whilst others are rejected being defective. This curve if drawn is bell shaped and its peak represents the mean value of the population. Numbers of places where a defect can occur are called opportunities and when in million such opportunities there are only 3.4 defects then it is said that yield has been treated by Six Sigma. Needless to say, Six Sigma Certification is the qualification to acquire.

Six Sigma as a management philosophy helps to focus on any element of production or service be it design or manufacturing. It focuses on design stage since it is easy to eliminate defects at this stage rather than at manufacturing stage. Thus Six Sigma is a strong link in organisation’s business strategy. Six Sigma Training helps focussing on the business strategy as it is itself a complete management system.

All Six Sigma teams have to use a check valve called DMAIC to ensure that Six Sigma projects stay on track and follow a step by step approach from beginning till end. Defining a defect, measuring it and then analysing data for best possible solution are the first three check points. Thereafter, the best solution is implemented and then the new process is controlled till the revenue starts pouring in again. Organisations are developing their own Six Sigma teams by sending almost all employees for the Six sigma Training. Though expensive the benefits accrued far outweigh the costs. That is why Six Sigma Training is so popular amongst the enterpreauners. Getting Six Sigma Certification is the way to success.

posts.title: Clinical Application Of Six Sigma
posts.bodyHtml:
As betterment in quality and dodging of mistakes is necessary in any official organisation, business industry or production unit; it is equally mandatory in the world of clinical processes also because they are related to the health of living beings and there is no place for mistake in such an important procedure. And a need for perfection increases all the more to ensure that the whole process is carried out in an efficient manner without committing even the smallest or insignificant blunders.

There are wide applications of the Six Sigma methodologies as far as clinical processes are concerned. As an instance, the Lean Six Sigma Training can help put in place a procedure that can be used to reduce the waiting time of patients at a doctor’s clinic. It is because when patients have to wait for long hours at the clinic and that too in an ill state of health; the patient forms a negative opinion about the doctor. The Six Sigma methodology organises the whole process in such a manner that all patients take an appointment from the doctor and then visit him according to the time specified to them via appointment. It reduces the unnecessary wastage of time at the patients’ end and the doctor is also stress-free as he knows how many patients he has to attend and performs his job more efficiently.

Similarly, there are medical processes related to surgery of patients, where sometimes patients have to even lose their precious life due to smallest mistakes committed by the doctors or carelessness on the part of the assistants. The Six Sigma Training ascertains that the whole process of surgery right from admission of the patient into the operating theatre till his safe discharge after accomplishment of the surgery is carried out in an efficient manner. It is done by assuring that all the necessary preparations have been made in the execution of a successful surgery. The preparations involve the proper functioning of all the medical gadgets, availability of all the necessary equipments, presence of relevant surgeons in the Operation Theater and arrangements for emergency in case the condition of the patient is too critical.

Following assurance of all the important equipments and processes, the Six Sigma Training ascertains that the surgery is carried out at set time by the expert surgeons and that no instrument is left inside the body of the patient. Although necessary precautions as well as measures are taken by all doctors but the significance of application of Six Sigma procedure lies in the fact that there is no place for any mistake in this process. To get the desired outcomes, hard efforts are made to make sure that the whole process is carried out in a trouble-free manner at each step.

Similarly, the process of Six Sigma can be applied to other fields of clinical processes such as in addressing Chemotherapy medication errors, Reducing Bloodstream Infections (BSIs) in one SICU and betterment in the infertility rates etc. The only important thing is to familiarise the whole medical staff with the methodologies of Six Sigma through Six Sigma Training and making sure that it is acceptable to them open-handed.

posts.title: No Scope For Failure With Lean Six Sigma
posts.bodyHtml:
The scope of failure can be reduced to almost nil by using the Six Sigma system. The Six Sigma is a special system aimed at business improvement. It seeks to improve the quality of process outputs by identifying and removing the errors or defects being carried out in the same. The Six Sigma follows a distinct sequence of steps that concentrate on process cycle time reduction, customer satisfaction, quality enhancement, profit maximisation, and cost reduction, etc. A candidate having undergone the Six Sigma Training put the Six Sigma methods to the execution in a company.

The highlight of Six Sigma:

The Six Sigma methodology possesses the capability to reduce the amount of errors or defects being carried out in the business process of a company to as low as 3.4 defects per million opportunities (DPMO). The Six Sigma process ensures a product developed under it to be 99.666% defect-free.

History of Six Sigma:

Originally, the Six Sigma was developed and put into the execution by Motorola Inc, USA in the year 1985. It initiated as a statistically-based method to reduce variation in the electronic manufacturing processes. Later, it was implemented for other processes related to business for the same purpose. The Six Sigma became well-known when Jack Welch used it as the central focus of his business strategy in 1995 at General Electric (GE). Since then, its popularity has spread like wildfire and it was adopted by a large number of organisations belonging to different business sectors across the world.

The Six Sigma has been adopted by different organisations such as government departments, hospitals, banks, MNCs, armed forces, etc. Famous companies across the world that adopted Six Sigma are Allied Signal, Apple Computer, Bank of USA, Bell Helicopter, Boeing, Intel, Ford, HP, Sony, Seagate, Fidelity, Microsoft, NASA, etc.

The Lean Six Sigma (LSS):

Lean and Six Sigma fuse to become Lean Six Sigma (LSS). The collaboration of the two related systems results in a single power packed system. This merger results in the elimination of wastes, a solution to the problem of overproduction and over-processing, the removal of defects and a considerable improvement in the quality. The DMAIC methodology involved in the Lean Six Sigma Training helps a company achieve a defect-free production process.

The companies these days require both Six Sigma and Lean Six Sigma specialists. The demand for internal competency in the same is on the rise. Therefore, the companies across the globe are adopting the Six Sigma Training as a discipline within their framework. The candidates after undergoing the training process emerge to be sharper and focused on the specified target.

The accreditation process varies for different companies. For accreditation, some associations require the candidates to participate in a Six Sigma project, while others require them to pass a written exam depending on the Six Sigma body of knowledge. The Six Sigma Certification is extended under the titles such as Master Black Belts, Black Belts, Green Belts, Orange Belts, Yellow Belts, and White Belts etc.

meta.title: Six Sigma Training : Two Project Methodology
meta.description: Discover how the two-project methodology in Six Sigma training helps professionals apply practical improvement techniques and deliver measurable results.

posts.title: Six Sigma Training : Two Project Methodology
posts.bodyHtml:
Methods of Six Sigma Training follow two project methodologies. These methodologies, are composed of five phases each under the headings - DMAIC & DMADV.

A. DMAIC is used for projects in order to improve, a business process and to cover business risks.

B. DMADV is used for projects in order to create new product or process designs.

A. DMAIC: Five phases of the DMAIC project methodology are detailed below:

(a) Define: It implies that we have to define the problem or the risk we have to remove the errors or faults of the business process. The voice of the customer is also to be defined. It means that we have to take care of the needs of the customer regarding the kind and quality of the products. We have to define the project goals also very specifically under Lean Six Sigma Training.

(b) Measure: It implies to measure major aspects of the existing process and collect relevant data. The pros and cons of the current process are evaluated in regard to the inputs (investments) manufacturing and sales etc. The relevant data in respect of these elements of the business process is collected very carefully under Six Sigma methodology.

(c) Analyse: The collected data undergoes sharp analysis for investigation and verification of cause and effect relationships. All factors are considered to know the errors and defects of the business process. The root causes of the defects are also sought under the Six Sigma Training.

(d) Improve: It means to improve the existing process based upon data analysis using techniques to remove error or defects. The techniques include design of experiments, mistake proofing and to create a new, beneficial business process. It is to set up a new capability as directed by Six Sigma.

(e) Control: Six Sigma method controls the incoming business process defects and all corrections are made to ensure risk less process. The control system should be implemented in production, purchases, manufacturing, sales, statistical processes, work place etc. Continuous monitoring of the business process is also necessary, otherwise, there is every possibility of occurrence of risk. Before defining, if we recognise an error or problem, the methodology becomes RDMAIC where R stands for Recognise. In some companies and organisations RDMAIC methodology is used.

B. DMADV or DFSS methodology: - This methodology is used when new products one to be created or new process designs are prepared. DFSS means "Design for Six Sigma"

This methodology also consists of 5 phases (similar to DMAIC methodology. Explanation of the 5 phases is elaborated below:

(a) Define: - This phase of Six Sigma methodology stresses defining the designs of the products. The designs must be according to the needs or demands of the customers. The policy of the organisation should be kept in view to meet the competitive demand of the market.

(b) Measure: - Second stage of Six Sigma methodology emphasises the measurement and identification of TQM features. Total quality management is very important to create the quality products. Capabilities of the enterprise to manufacture products, manufacturing process and profit or losses are also measured and identified.

(c) Analyse: - Analyse phase of Six Sigma strategy deals with analysis of the design and to create new designs for the manufacture of quality items.

(d) Design: - Depending upon the design analysis, Six Sigma methodology helps to prepare improved designs of the quality products. The new designs should be acceptable to the customers.

(e) Verify: - The product design is verified and is implemented in the business process.

Thus, the Six Sigma methodology helps to produce quality goods with best designs as per the demands of the customers for the maximum outputs.

posts.title: Six Sigma Training : All You Need To Know
posts.bodyHtml:
The fundamental reason of project-failure in an organisation is the inability on its part to rectify the defects being carried out in a project. This is exactly where the Six Sigma Training comes to the fore to prove its significance. To know more about the training and its benefits, it is imperative to know about the Six Sigma system in detail.

The Six Sigma System:

The Six Sigma system offers an extraordinary methodology that identifies errors or defects in the work process of a company and aims at removing them. The Six Sigma methodology extends a specialised series of steps aimed at quality improvement, product development and customer satisfaction. The Six Sigma system is based on the principle of Total Quality Management (TQM). The incredible part about the Six Sigma methodology is that it reduces the quantity of errors being carried out in the work process of a company to almost nil or 3.4 defects per million (going by the stats). The Six Sigma system has evolved to play three different roles in an organisation. Firstly, it functions as a metric, secondly as a methodology and thirdly as a management system.

As a metric, it is used as a scale for the amount of defects being carried out in the work process of a company. As a methodology it concentrates on business improvement and as a management system it provides a framework that prioritises projects and resources to help function a company as per its business strategy and achieve the desired level of success.

The Six Sigma system came into being in the mid 1980s as a method to reduce variation in the manufacturing processes in Motorola Inc in the USA. The system has originally been developed by Motorola Inc. With the progression of time, the system emerged as an all-inclusive business performance methodology and is increasingly being used in different types of organisations such as government departments, hospitals, banks, armed forces and multi-national corporations. The most popular corporations in the world that have adopted the Six Sigma system are Sony, Apple Computer, Seagate, Boeing, US Air Force, HP, GE, Motorola etc.

The Six Sigma Training:

The Six Sigma Training is exclusively meant to enable the candidates to implement the Six Sigma methodologies effectively in an organisation. The training offers considerable practical exposure to the candidates. Additionally, the candidates develop the knowledge and ability to handle the projects at an international level. Undergoing the training process packs an individual with a handsome amount of experience and gets his core management skills sharpened to a great extent. The training fundamentally enables the candidates to run the projects using the Six Sigma strategy in the workplace.

The Lean Six Sigma Training is also playing a substantial role in the organisations as it helps them in eliminating redundant processes being carried out in their work process, which thereby eliminates all the inefficiencies and enhances the quality. The Lean Six Sigma Training also ensures timely completion of tasks and helps an organisation establish a good reputation in the market.

The Six Sigma Certification is imparted as per the level of the candidates’ expertise under the different heads – Champions, Master Black Belts, Black Belts, Green Belts and Orange Belts.

Introduction to the Six Sigma:-

The Six Sigma is popularly known as a project management system. At its core, the Six Sigma system is a unique methodology which identifies the defects in the work process of a company and aims to remove them. As a matter of fact, the Six Sigma system was developed by Motorola Inc. in 1985 as a tool for quality improvement. However, the Six Sigma system gained popularity among organisations across the world in the year 2000 and is being used vigorously in the business sector since then. The Six Sigma system works on the principle of standard deviations, the accuracy of which is almost 100%. It is this accuracy that reduces the defect-level in the production process of a company to 3.4 per million.

The Lean Six Sigma (LSS):

The Six Sigma system has the Lean Six Sigma (LSS) as its extension. The Lean Six Sigma (LSS) is a special method that concentrates on creating more with less. The Lean Six Sigma (LSS) method also caters to the problem of overproduction in an organisation. In the wake of stiff competition among the companies functioning in the market, cost of production plays a crucial role. The Lean Six Sigma methodology helps in the reduction of costs by eliminating unnecessary processes that are being carried out in a company. The productivity of the workforce, as well as the quality of products, is also aimed at by the Lean Six Sigma methodology. In fact, the Lean Six Sigma system offers a sequence of effective steps to be taken for costs and waste reduction and maximisation of profits.

Based on the Six Sigma and the Lean Six Sigma methodologies, we have the Lean Six Sigma Training available in the market. The candidates trained under this training course excel in expertise and productivity and are ranked amongst the top notch candidates in the field of business management. The demand for such candidates is mounting with more and more organisations wishing to adopt the Six Sigma methodology. The level of expertise among the candidates opting for the Six Sigma Training differs. Accordingly, the candidates are allotted different ranks. The ranks are the Six Sigma Champion, the Six Sigma Green Belt, the Six Sigma Orange Belt and the Six Sigma Black Belt. Among these, the Six Sigma Black Belt holders are the most in-demand and efficient candidates.

There is an examination route to attain the credential, namely, the Six Sigma Certification. The Six Sigma Certification is a key to get recognised as a true business management professional, well-versed in the implementation of Six Sigma methods. Undergoing the training process also helps one to polish his core management skills such as planning, problem solving, decision making and communicating.

posts.title: The Quest For Idealism And Lean Six Sigma
posts.bodyHtml:
All entrepreneurs want their organisation to run in an ideal manner. The operational processes, the delivery systems, the marketing strategies and quality control which are the pillars of an enterprise must be functional at all times at their highest efficiency so that the output of production is also ideal. The idealism here means that the yield should be near perfect. In other words, the output should be defect free. The only methodology which is in existence since 1986 is the Six Sigma methodology. It can stretch a production process to give a near perfect yield having only 3.4 defects in a million opportunities. The ideal metric of any yield is the magic figure stated above and all production managers are therefore in pursuit to achieve this near perfect yield. Six Sigma Course has been designed to educate the management professionals in the statistical methods associated with Six Sigma.

The standard deviation curve is a well known statistical figure that is a graphical representation of the mathematical figure sigma whose values at extremes are the quality control limits that a product can have. All items having the quality specifications within the extreme values are considered acceptable and those outside are called defects. The production team tries to minimise the defects. The other process can be to reduce the number of opportunities that can provide the space for a defect to occur. This increases the speed of a process and hence the word ‘lean’ represents speed of a process. Six Sigma Training covers all these aspects.

The fact that Six Sigma is a methodology that improves all the operational processes in addition to it being a measure qualifies it to be termed as a complete management system. The management professionals who undergo the Six Sigma Course thus have an edge over their compatriots who only hold a college management degree. It is for this reason that Six Sigma Training is so very popular that all kinds of academics and institutions are offering such Courses. The management professional is well advised to check the proper accreditations and affiliation before enrolling for a Six Sigma Course.

The Six Sigma Course is an expensive proposition in terms of time and the involvement of almost all the employees. It is for this reason that a Six Sigma project is chosen with care and being absolutely sure of its need to improve the operational processes. Ultimately after the improvements have been affected and the returns start flooding the expenses incurred on a Six Sigma project are more than compensated for. The Six Sigma Certification makes sure that you are capable of heading a Six Sigma team that ensures success.

Six Sigma Certification can be considered to be an entry point in the arena of your professional success as a project manager. The determination of a defect and then finding the best possible solution to eradicate it is the most satisfying experience and thus job satisfaction is assured. Six Sigma Training will train you to achieve the desired success in your organisation.

posts.title: Pursue Excellence With Six Sigma Training
posts.bodyHtml:

It was first imbibed by Motorola in the 1980s and later implemented by companies like GE and Ford and then by many organisations all over the world. The management of Ford decided to launch Six Sigma training quality improvement programme with dual objective of enhancing vehicle quality and improving customer satisfaction. Six Sigma training enables you to adopt measures which ensure a zero error in all processes of production.

Without going into mathematical details, the measure between standard deviation and the mean of the population is called dispersion. In any production process, there is an item to item variation. Sigma is the measure of this variation. The acceptable limits of quality specifications are laid down. Earlier three sigma was the best measure that meant that 99. 73 percent of products were within the acceptable limits. Only 0.27 per cent was wastage. However, Six Sigma assures that 99.99 percent of products are within the specifications. The wastage is therefore only two parts per billion. These figures are meant to give you an idea of accuracy that is achieved in Six Sigma production process. The statistical part of Six Sigma will be covered in Six Sigma course or Six Sigma training.

posts.title: Lean Six Sigma Training Does The Cause And Effect Analysis
posts.bodyHtml:
The essence of carrying out any Six Sigma project in an organisation is to remove or decrease the variation in the quality or design specifications for an item that is caused due to mass production. Practically one cannot achieve a production that is fully devoid of any defective item. Some items will deviate from specifications because you are in a manufacturing process that is producing million items of a product in one go. What can be however done is to reduce this variation to bare minimum and that is the core address of a Six Sigma process. It evaluates the cause and measures the effect to suggest the best possible solution to minimise the variation. Lean Six Sigma training is designed to train you to learn the techniques of applying Six Sigma processes to cause and effect analysis.

Cause and effect is a technique which may be used in improving processes. There may be different causes that affect a given problem. This helps generate thought processes and reveal hidden relationships that are root causes of the problem. As soon as a defect is declared finding the root cause of the defect becomes the mission of the Six Sigma teams. Six Sigma training trains you to learn about the cause and effect analysis as a valuable tool for problem solving. It can help the Six Sigma teams focus on the cause or group of causes that are affecting the quality of a product.

Once the cause or group of causes that are causing the defect are identified the analysis shifts to finding the list of possible solutions to the problem. Then the Six Sigma narrows down to identifying the best possible solution. The new solution is then implemented. Thereafter, the new procedure is controlled and observed to verify that defect has been eradicated and the yield now is acceptable to the market and customers. Six Sigma training Cambridge will cover the above under the topic DMAIC process. The acronym DMAIC stands for Define, Measure, Analyse, Implement and Control.

As you may have noticed, Six Sigma is a measure of quality of yield (3.4 defects per million opportunities). In addition, it is also a methodology since it addresses the needs of the customers. With these two characteristics Six Sigma becomes a complete management process since all operational processes of an organisation also improve along with the process of problem solving. The build up to problem solving brings all procedures and processes under scanner of the improvement process.

Though Six Sigma is time consuming and involves almost all the employees of the organisation Six Sigma is therefore a very costly preposition. However, the paybacks received after implementation of the Six Sigma process in an organisation more than compensate for the expenses incurred. Six Sigma training is thus a popular course to do to enable you to be a vital and important part of the improvement process. The post of project champion can be yours if you have done Six Sigma certification.

posts.title: Six Sigma Training: The Progression To Perfection
posts.bodyHtml:

The number of defects in manufacturing increases if there are too many hands handling its manufacture along the process. More the steps of the process more are the opportunity for the defects to occur. Thus the number of defects is based upon the number of opportunities. The metric of Six Sigma is the measure of a number of defects per opportunity. The methodology of Six Sigma has the capability to give only 3.4 defects per million opportunities. This amounts to almost zero-defect yield hence approaches near perfection.

Another advantage of Six Sigma is that it acts as a catalyst for process improvement. The design department lays down the design and quality specifications based upon the needs of the customers. The production processes who mass produce the item try to meet all these specifications. However, not all items produced are perfect. Defects do occur. The endeavour is to reduce these defects to a minimum. This can happen only if you improve the processes in such a way that they give only 3.4 defects in a million opportunities. Thus Six Sigma helps improves processes and also it caters to the needs of the customers. Hence, the popularity of the Lean Six Sigma training is increasing day by day.

From the above, it is clear that Six Sigma is a metric as well a methodology to improve processes. Coupled with the fact that it also addresses the voice of customer a complete management system is evolved whilst implementing Six Sigma in the organisation. Actually, Six Sigma cannot be wished away by organisation since it is a complete management system. Though all employees get involved in a Six Sigma project and go for various Six Sigma training programmes costing the company a lot of money and time. However, these disadvantages are offset by the high paybacks that Six Sigma gives. Organisations, as varied as hospitals, prisons, local bodies, hospitality sector, insurance sector and the MNCs, are deploying Six Sigma trained personnel so that they too can achieve near perfect yields.

An organisation takes u four to five Six Sigma projects per year. That means a Six Sigma trained person would always be in demand by the industries. As a customer you have full right to reject any item which has a defect. Even a small fault in manufacturing can cause a permanent loss of a customer and trust in brand name. Whatever field of business you are in- whether it is manufacturing, engineering, utilities or construction there would always exist a need to produce almost perfect product. Lean Six Sigma training addresses the issue of rectifying any error which may occur in the business.

An entrepreneur has to ensure that customer is always satisfied. Being aware of what a customer needs lays the foundation of design of the product. A perfect balance between needs of a customer and the business organisation has to be maintained. A trust between them is established by the quality of the product. A manufacturer ensures an error free product and a customer buys this near perfect product from the market. Six Sigma training ensures that yield and capability of the company are maximised. The voice of customer makes Six Sigma a methodology of management. This is the reason many business professionals are seeking Six Sigma training.

Six Sigma as a measure gives near perfection. Standard deviation is a measure of central tendency. This is a bell shaped curve. A vertical line drawn from the peak of the bell to a calibrated scale at its base represents the mean of a data. A deviation to the left or right of this line is the standard deviation from the mean and is represented by a Greek symbol sigma. Six times sigma means on an average, on scale zero to one you are almost nearing one which means almost perfect. In other words the items which fall short of minimum acceptable limits of quality specification and those that exceed the upper limit are called defects. Achieving a figure of having only 3.4 defects in a yield of million is the measure of perfection of Six Sigma. Thus the name Six Sigma is a brand name and Six Sigma course teaches you about precision in business processes.

Any leader has to be aware of the market and latest trends. Keeping oneself isolated is sure to lead one to doom. History teaches you the dangers of being isolated. Jimmy Carter was isolated by his staff. Nixon was not kept informed about the dangers or the consequences of the Watergate break-in. President Johnson did not have a clue about the public opinions and feelings about Vietnam until it was too late. Listening to the voice of a customer as far as a manufacturer is concerned, is a vital issue covered in Six Sigma courses.

Enrol for Six Sigma training and make your organisation march ahead by winning customers due to its top quality product. Also, Six Sigma course is equivalent to doing a full management degree since the blend of Six Sigma as a metric and as a methodology qualifies it as such. This is the strength of Six Sigma training.

Six Sigma is a systematic approach in the process of improvement and reduction of discrepancies in any business processes by identification and removal of faults or defects which usually emerge at any stage of the business process. The Six Sigma set of tools and strategies are generally designed at providing a near perfect business result by eliminating all possible errors and defects. It was first developed by the telecommunication company, Motorola and later adopted by an abundant number of organisations, most notable among them being General Electrics.

posts.title: Achieve Perfection With Six Sigma Training
posts.bodyHtml:
Six Sigma training is the new age mantra for attaining near perfection in your products and processes. So what exactly is six sigma? Well, it is a methodology that aims at reducing errors and variation to a minimum so that the perfect piece of product or process can be produced. It was originally developed by Motorola in 1985 and since then has evolved and been widely adopted across various industries. The main aim is to improve the quality of the process through the identification and removal of errors that have occurred. This greatly minimises the variability in the manufacturing process of a product.

Lean Six Sigma certification was originally intended for small private organisations but with the passage of time and its success rate, it has been deployed by government organizations. Since its inception, six sigma has firmly established a foothold in the professional arena and various organisations across the globe have adopted its methods and profited and gained success in their organization.

Six Sigma processes fall under two categories:

DMAIC-Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve and Control-its focus is on improving existing processes which fall short of set standards.

DMADV-Define, Measure, Analyze, Design, Verify-This emphasizes the development of new processes and products at a Six Sigma level-based approach to quality.

The DMAIC consists of five stages:

Define, the goals of projects and customer specifications.

Measure, key features of the current process and collection of related data.

Analyse, the root causes of defection.

Improve, on the current process using data analysis.

Control, by being proactive and preventing problems before they occur.

The DMADV consists of five stages:

Define, goals which are in sync with customer demands.

Measure and identify CTQ(Characteristics which are critical to quality)

Analyse, to develop alternatives.

Now an explanation of how the various belts work in the training course. The yellow belt is the ‘starters’ belt and the first one to be achieved. Once the yellow belt in this training has been achieved you will have the onus of carrying out strategies which are devised by six sigma and find new routes to implement them in a practical work environment. The next level up is the six sigma green belt training . On accomplishing this you will be in charge of the bulk six sigma related work that occurs in the organization. The six sigma black belt is a leadership profile which enables you to take charge of projects that will be taking place. The most advanced level of achievement in six sigma is the master black belt which has a great responsibility profile and this will e for the project manager or the supervisor profile of the project.

A six sigma certification involves learning the relevant syllabi, clearing a written proficiency test and being able to demonstrate the practical application to real work conditions. There are a number of accredited and widely recognised institutes that offer these courses and cater to individual needs. The training is a blended approach of online and classroom training. The tests are administered by the training institutes or the businesses hiring them. With this information at your fingertips, you are in a well-informed position to decide to go for a lean six sigma training course. So, go for it!

Lean Six Sigma training and Six Sigma certification are thus high profile qualifications to add to your CV.

posts.bodyHtml:
In order to produce a defect free yield all organisations have been seeking the Six Sigma expertise to maximise their production. In addition, all processes can also be improved. Lean Six Sigma course teaches all about the aspects of quality control in manufacturing and continuous process improvement.
The reason Six Sigma process is so effective is that it gives flawless yield. Statistically speaking sigma is a measure of dispersion. When the company decides to produce an item it sets certain standard design specifications which must be complied with. When the production starts each item is measured for its quality and those falling below and above the least and highest acceptable limits are rejected and termed as defective pieces. It is thus endeavour of any production house to minimise these defects. Six Sigma techniques stretch this exercise to such an extent that it gives almost or tending to zero- defect production. In terms of defect it means 3.4 defects in a million opportunities. A Six Sigma certification will cover all aspects of dispersion and teach you to use it as a metric.
The greatest asset of Six Sigma is that the techniques can be applied for process improvement too. The process should have a minimum of steps so that customer can get efficient and quick service. All process improvements are based on needs of the customer. Total customer satisfaction is the aim of all organisations and therefore the voice of the customer is given prominence. Six Sigma training will teach you all about identifying customer needs and thus qualify Six Sigma as a methodology too.
Six Sigma teams are divided into various classes based on the colour scheme of Judo. The green belts are given a week's training in Six Sigma and they are the organisation employees who work hands -on on the manufacturing lines or processes. Black belts do a three weeks training and they assist the green belts in finding the defects or problems. Master black belts are the men who guide both the green and black belts in Six Sigma techniques. Over and above them are the Project Champions who are handpicked by the top management to implement and control the improvement procedures. A Lean Six Sigma certification will empower you to be Master Black belt and if you are already a manager in the organisation you can be the Project Champion.
The whole of Six Sigma technique is followed logically to produce better output. It uses a watchdog called DMAIC to ensure that all Six Sigma projects remain on track. It aims to first define the problem, then measure it, analyse all possible solutions, chooses the best solution, implements it and lastly control it till returns on revenue start flowing in. By doing Six Sigma certification you will be adding value to your professional portfolio and you shall always find yourself employed since all organisations are doing Six Sigma projects.

posts.title: Lean Six Sigma: The Perfect Methodology
posts.bodyHtml:
Six Sigma is a methodology that works towards achieving perfection in its processes. It was first introduced by Motorola in 1985. By reduction of defects, Six Sigma saves time and money and contributes to customer satisfaction. It is used both in the existing products and services and also new products and services. Six sigma is a unique philosophy and is quite often a target for achievement in many organisations.

Six Sigma training consists of the following main training:

SIX SIGMA GREEN BELT TRAINING: This is a route which will lead you from being a team member to the position of a project manager through the acquisition of relevant skills. Once you have demonstrated your ability as a six sigma yellow belt moving on to six sigma green belt training would be the most obvious route. This training focuses on the basics of six sigma framework, variations and processes.

SIX SIGMA GREEN BELT CERTIFICATION: With this certification, you will acquire the ability to analyse and solves problems qualitatively and also demonstrate a solid knowledge of six sigma tools and processes. You would be basically working as a support to Six sigma black belt and under its supervision.

SIX SIGMA BLACK BELT TRAINING: This training will make you an expert in process improvement. Problems are attended to for considerable cost savings, improved quality and provide significant benefits to customers and suppliers. They are mentors to six sigma green belts and the newer black belts.

SIX SIGMA BLACK BELT CERTIFICATION- With the six sigma black belt certification demonstrates your sound understanding of six sigma philosophies and principles and also a thorough understanding of all aspects of the DMAIC (Define, Measure, Analyse, Improve and Control) model in sync. with six sigma principles.

Six sigma has been combined with another concept called ‘lean’. Lean basically consists of the elimination of wasteful functions and processes of an organisation.

Lean Six Sigma and Lean Six Sigma courses impart lean six sigma training that is an integrated managerial approach of combining lean and six sigma. This process utilises the concept of DMAIC. The trainee personnel are designated and classified as per the martial arts classification system i.e white belts, yellow belts, green belts, black belts and master black belts.

  • THE WHITE BELTS: They go through a complex level overview based training. They get well familiarised with some basic terminology about six sigma. They assist green belts or black belts with data collection.
  • THE GREEN BELTS: They are trained from a few days up to two weeks and basically focus on projects in their own functional areas. They are not well acquainted with advanced six sigma concepts.
  • BLACK BELTS: They are trained for a period of a week to four weeks. They are capable of working on strategically more complex and cross-functional projects.
  • MASTER BLACK BELTS: They mentor and coach green belts and black belts. They also take on bigger projects for a large company.
  • YELLOW BELTS: They review the improvement of processes and assist and support the project.

A six sigma certification involves knowledge of concepts and their practical application. The company that hires the institute or the institute itself conducts the test. It is an integrated module of online and classroom training. Six sigma is the most user-friendly tool for devising a near defection strategy.

posts.title: Lean Six Sigma Training - Quality Tool
posts.bodyHtml:
Six Sigma is an excellent quality control tool. It is a successor to the earlier quality control methods such as Kaizen and Total Quality Management which were very popular Japanese quality control tools till the 1980s. They were able to give a quality yield of 3 Sigma. However, Motorola which used the Six Sigma techniques to reduce the variation in electronic manufacturing managed to stretch the process of quality control to Six Sigma which gave a near perfect yield of 99.999886 %. Such is thus the limit of Six Sigma and since then management professionals are doing Six Sigma training to be able to be part of Six Sigma teams of the organisations.

The process of Six Sigma involves almost all the employees of the organisation. The Six Sigma project is undertaken with lot of scrutiny. It starts only when the top management is sure that a defect really exists in the manufacturing process or in a service. Once the Six Sigma project begins it tends to envelop all the employees for whom the success of the Six Sigma project becomes their personal liability. The line workers are sent for a week’s Lean Six Sigma course to be termed as Green Belts. The junior managers do two weeks to four weeks Six Sigma training to become Black Belts. Similarly, middle level mangers do the Master Black Belt course of six weeks duration. They then assist the green and Black Belts in doing the projects. Finally, there are Project Champions who are the management’s choice under whose supervision the whole project takes place. This is the chain of command for Six Sigma projects which you shall learn about in Six Sigma certification course.

As a technique, Six Sigma is a metric as well as a methodology. The metric of having only 3.4 defects in a million opportunities is the wish figure of every enterpreauner. As a methodology Six Sigma addresses the core of business strategy of the modern era, that is, the voice of the customer. It is the customer who specifies the design and features and to some extent the price too of a product. The Six Sigma teams endeavour to meet all the specification desires of the customers. The Six Sigma is the best quality control tool and is the ultimate brand of marketing strategy too. When both the metric and the methodology of Six Sigma combine, it becomes a complete management system which improves all the business processes. Thus doing Lean Six Sigma certification makes you a complete management professional.

The process of Six Sigma from start to finish is controlled by another management tool called DMAIC. It is a very logical approach to problem solving. The defect is first defined. This requires study of feedback data received directly or indirectly from customers. Once the defect has been defined then they measure it viz how much is the defect percentage. Then analysis takes place to find out various options of solutions available and choosing the best of them. The best solution is then implemented and the new process is then controlled till the process improves and the new process is fully accepted by employees as well as customers. Thus Six Sigma training empowers you to b the implementer of the progressive process

Keeping the mathematical details aside, let us try and understand the concept of dispersion. The measure between Standard Deviation and Mean of the population is called dispersion. In a manufacturing process dispersion is measured from item to item. Sigma is the measure of this dispersion and the aim therefore is to control this dispersion and minimise it to the optimum. The items which do not measure up to the value of dispersion are called defects. These are kept to the bare minimum. Earlier in the days when kaizen and Total Quality Management, the process which gave a value of three sigma (0.27% wastage) was acceptable. Only when the processes were stretched to Six Sigma the industry woke up to the figure of having only 3.4 defects per million opportunities (almost zero% wastage). This is the kind of efficiency which you will be able to provide the top management of your organisation after doing Lean Six Sigma certification.

The defects occur because of the opportunities. More the number of opportunities, more will be the chances of defects. Hence, the endeavour of the enterpreauners is to minimise the opportunities so that the defects automatically get minimised. In other words, let the process have as few steps or as few hands as possible through which it passes. Reducing the number of steps in the process shall increase the speed of the process. This is what being lean is about. Lean Six Sigma training teaches the concepts of process being Lean.

Six Sigma process is being used in the fields of manufacturing, utilities, engineering and construction. Six Sigma certified personnel are in great demand due to the zero –error production needs of every organisation worth its name in the national and international market.

Six Sigma is a great methodology which listens to the voice of the customers and does everything in its power to satisfy their demands by providing the vital technology links to the organisation so that both quality and technology are coupled to be a solid combination. The business processes also improve generating extra profits.

One of the integral parts of Six Sigma projects in any organisation is the training of employees. If you are a man who has leaning towards training others then you should go in for Master Black Belts course so that you become the trainer for the Green and Black belts. Over and above all these are Project Champions who together with Master Black Belts are empowered to identify Six Sigma projects for the company and offer resources to the main persons responsible for implementing the projects.

Therefore, doing Six Sigma training is the most important step towards managing a zero error business environment. Do Six Sigma certification and shine like a pole star in the field of Six Sigma projects.

posts.title: Lean Six Sigma: Success Defined
posts.bodyHtml:
WHAT IS SIX SIGMA?

Six Sigma is an approach that is based on data. Its goal is to achieve near-zero defects. The main focus is on the elimination of defects almost completely. This approach is used in manufacturing, transactions, products and services.

Six Sigma can be achieved if out of total productivity of a million there are no more than 3.4 defects. Whenever there is a deviation from customer specifications it results in a Six Sigma defect. Six Sigma is based on the principle of improvement of projects and variation reduction.

Six Sigma processes fall under two categories:

DMAIC-Define, Measure, Analyse, Improve and Control-its focus is on improving existing processes which fall short of set standards.

DMADV-Define, Measure, Analyse, Design, Verify-This emphasises the development of new processes and products at a Six Sigma level-based approach to quality.

SIX SIGMA TRAINING

Six Sigma courses support the following roles which are required to be carried out for successful implementation:

  • Executive leader
  • Champions
  • Master Black Belts
  • Green Belts

WHAT IS LEAN?

The concept of lean focuses on cutting out wasteful processes in the functions and processes of an organisation.

LEAN SIX SIGMA COURSES

Lean Six Sigma courses are a balanced blend of lean and six sigma. They are based on the concept of DMAIC. The employees are designated as per the martial arts classification system i.e white belts, yellow belts, green belts, black belts and master black belts.

THE WHITE BELTS: It starts with an introduction to some basic terminology. They perform a support function to green belts or black belts and this involves data collection. It lasts for a brief period of up to four hours.

THE GREEN BELTS: The training starts from a few days up to two weeks and lays emphasis on employee-specific functional areas. They are not familiar with higher levels of advanced concepts of six sigma courses.

BLACK BELTS: The training period consists of a week to four weeks. It involves being able to manage strategically more complex and cross-functional projects.

MASTER BLACK BELTS: They lead and coach green belts and black belts. They also manage more complex business projects.

YELLOW BELTS: They track and monitor the improvement of processes and assist and support the project.

SIX SIGMA CERTIFICATION-ITS SIGNIFICANCE

The Six Sigma certification is important because:

  • The proficiency of the subject is defined.
  • Gives a considerable hike to the pay package.
  • It is a highly sought after and valued qualification for and by the prospective employers.

SIX SIGMA CERTIFICATION

A six sigma certification involves learning the relevant subject matter, passing a written proficiency test and being able to demonstrate a practical application to real work environments. The whole process of Six Sigma and the improvements affected thereby are focussed at giving a near-perfect yield. Statistically, you would learn by doing Six Sigma certification that there can only be 3.4 defects in a million opportunities. The statistical methods deployed, to achieve this kind of yield is the focus of Six Sigma training.

Teamwork is essential to the Six Sigma process. It cannot be applied by a single individual or a leader. He has to involve all the employees of the organisation. It has to be teamwork. Various teams are formed to study the processes and identify the why and how of a defect. The green belts, the black belts and super black belts are the various categories of Six Sigma qualifications and these professionals head the teams at various layers of Six Sigma project. Getting at that near-perfect yield becomes a matter of pride for all employees since a near-perfect quality brings in the revenue which translates into enhanced pay and allowances for the employees. Apart from being simply a metric (3.4 defects per million), the Six Sigma is a methodology too since it addresses the issues of customer satisfaction and improvement of processes. The amalgamation of both results in Six Sigma being a complete management system. Applying Six Sigma as a management system improves the operational efficiency of the organisation and makes the processes fast-paced. This is the reason to go in for Lean Six Sigma training. The word Lean signifies speed and agility. This can be achieved if a process passes through a minimum number of hands from the start to its end.

Go for six sigma certification or Lean Six Sigma course to become adept at process improvement methods and providing optimum customer satisfaction. The consumerism stands atop the heap of business strategies.

posts.title: Lean Six Sigma Training: Quality Philosophy
posts.bodyHtml:
Six Sigma is a quality philosophy that talks about achievable short-term goals while striving for a long term objective. One of the several benefits of applying Six Sigma is that it introduces rapid and almost radical improvements. Several of the quality initiatives of the earlier days such as Quality Circles, Kaizen and Quality Function deployment are very necessary for an organisation at all times. However, by their very nature, these measures produce incremental improvements. The pace of improvement is therefore quite slow. In addition to these kinds of improvements, any firm in today’s fast-changing business world needs improvement to be brought in very rapidly in order to match the pace of changing technologies and changing customer requirements. Surely, Six Sigma is such an instrument of change, which can bring about radical changes in the way an organisation functions. Hence, Lean Six Sigma certification is must understand what a business needs to excel.

When Six Sigma is implemented, the entire organisation in all its constituent parts is geared for absorbing rapid and radical changes. One cannot possibly bring in large changes in one part of the organisation, without adequate measures in the other parts. Six Sigma initiatives make the management to take a closer look at the various functions and departments and the inter-relationships between them. Six Sigma training will throw light on the effects of Six Sigma on the organisation as a whole.

Also, by its very nature, Six Sigma provides measures and targets that are quantifiable. Specific defects- deviations from the customer requirements – are identified and measured. Improvement performance is also measured. Consistently uniform measurability is one of its important distinguishing characteristics. One can take the Organisation to that level of efficiency only after you have done the Six Sigma course.

Organisational changes are brought about by the implementation of Six Sigma. These transformations are general in nature. But, the improvements they generate can be and should be measurable against the yardstick. That is why Six Sigma uses ‘customer requirements’ as the yardstick. The benefits of constant measurements are that the customer is always in focus with his requirements being the standard against which the measurements are done. Due to the presence of Six Sigma, an organisation is always aware of the changes in the market. Since Six Sigma is a measurement-based initiative and also being a methodology it takes the shape of a management system. Six Sigma certification will enlighten you on this subject.

The organisation that implements this initiative would have to constantly keep itself apprised of the customer’s requirements. In short, a Six Sigma initiative is an ongoing process and is forever. It is true that Six Sigma signifies radical improvement. In this dynamic process, as the customer requirements change, the performance may not remain at Six Sigma. It may descend, necessitating another round of Six Sigma efforts. So one needs to have a proper understanding of the process which can be attained with Six Sigma training or Six Sigma certification.

posts.title: How Is Six Sigma Training Useful?
posts.bodyHtml:
One important aspect when it comes to a company irrespective of its size is the quality of the company or an enterprise. There is no alternative for quality. Even though there are multiple companies producing or delivering the same type of product, the one who provides better quality will always stay ahead among the rest irrespective o the price tag. That is the importance that the consumers give for the quality of the product that they purchase and to ensure that a company is delivering better quality, they have a separate department for analysing quality. There were multiple ways that were followed to analyse the quality of the product, however, the latest and the most accurate means is Six Sigma training. What is so special about Six Sigma? The answer for this question can be understood only if we know what exactly Six Sigma is and how it is calculated to get better results in quality. Before Six Sigma came into existence, all the companies were using only percentage measurement to calculate quality and they strive to get 100 percent quality on the products that they produce or deliver.

However, even though you achieve 100 per cent it does not mean that the product is of high quality and this was understood only after Lean Six Sigma Training was developed. This is because, on using percentage calculations, what we exactly do is we give the quality report for 1 defect in 100 opportunities. For example, let us take a company which is manufacturing thousands of numbers of a product each day and to do a percentage calculation what they do is that they randomly select 100 number of the product and check for the defect and they calculate it and give the measurement in percentage. Even though this is correct, since we consider only 100 numbers out of thousands, the opportunity or the probability of getting a defected piece is very minimal. However, when it comes to Six Sigma, it is calculated as 1 defect per million opportunities. Due to this, there is more probability of finding the defected piece using Six Sigma and there is a better opportunity for the company to get more appropriate quality report and thereby this would make them improve their quality standards better.

In short, the major calculation term used in Six Sigma calculation is DPMO which is nothing but the abbreviated term of Defects per Million Opportunities. This is the major part in Six Sigma calculations and this is where Six Sigma becomes much more accurate. It is said that Six Sigma is 99.99666666 percent accurate. However, with this calculation, it becomes very tough for a company to achieve this percentage, however, a figure around that in Six Sigma calculation result proves to be much more perfect than the percentage calculations. Now, most of the enterprises are using Six Sigma as their quality measurement method. Moreover, they need a Six Sigma certified professional for their quality team. The Six Sigma certification has multiple stages and it starts with a Six Sigma yellow belt for the basics, Six Sigma green belt for intermediate, Six Sigma Black belt for senior level and Six Sigma Master Black belt for the masters which is the last and the most advanced certification in Six Sigma.

The Six Sigma theme is based on customer satisfaction. Once you know what a customer wants then the next step is to find out the ways to deliver what they want. The answer lies in improving the processes your company uses to generate the services and products you sell. Six Sigma training trains you to discover the methods of improving processes in your organisation.

An American statistician, Dr W Edwards who led the quality movement in Japan firmly believed that 85% of faults were due to the defective process and only 15% due to an individual’s mistake. He followed this 85/15 rule all his life but in the last few years of his life, he admitted that maybe he was wrong about 85/15 rule. It should have been 96/04 rule. In other words, the processes are responsible for most of the quality problems and not the person. Six sigma training teaches you all about identifying a defect in the process.

You would have noticed that whenever something goes wrong people use their experience and trial-and-error method to come up with a solution to the problem. Lean Six Sigma changes this methodology by laying stress on documenting how work gets done, examining the flow of work between people or workstations and giving people knowledge and methods to constantly improve their work. Lean Six Sigma training will teach you different methods of process improvement.

The majority of process improvement work falls in one of these two categories viz to eliminate variation and improve process flow and speed. Six Sigma certification enlightens you to the meaning of sigma. It is a Greek word used in statistics to stand for the amount of variation seen in a process, in a set of data or anything that is measurable. Everything in this world varies. The important thing to note is the way it varies. If it varies within the acceptable limits of standards set by the customers we say that there is no defect. If it varies lees or more than prescribed acceptable standards then it is a defect. When we say Six Sigma it means that 99.99966% yield is fit enough to be sold in the market. That is almost approaching 100%. It means there is zero defect yield of a product or a service. This is the beauty of Six sigma and you learn it in detail doing Six Sigma certification.

Six Sigma training will train you to analyse how the workflows through the process. You analyse the handoff from one workstation to the other. You study the physical path that the work follows in an office or on the floor of a factory and you will be able to identify the defect in the process. Thereafter, by applying DMAIC technique you will be able to rectify the procedural flaws. Six Sigma course will help you get rid of the waste in the process and even come up with an innovation to launch a new process or a product.

Six sigma reigns supreme in process improvement and it is for you to do Six Sigma certification to scale the heights of professionalism.

posts.title: The Evolution Of Six Sigma And Lean Six Sigma
posts.bodyHtml:
Six Sigma is a comprehensive strategy pursued by the organisations to bring about breakthrough improvements in their processes and products and services. Since it is a statistical tool and quantitatively measures the quality of processes, it is more of the real world and less theoretical.

At the core of six sigma, lies the concept of identifying the redundant processes in the internal and external value chain of an organisation and eliminating them to bring about a reduction in cost and adding more value to the output created by the organisation. Six sigma prescribes the tolerance for variation in output created by an organisation at 3.40 defective units in every one million units of output created.

Six Sigma involves continuous and persistent efforts on the part of the organisation to upgrade the quality and deliver greater value to the customer. Since six sigma is a measurement oriented approach, it enables the professionals to understand clearly in objective terms the current status of the organisation in regard to quality and also helps them in seeing where they are heading to.

Two methodologies are used in implementing six sigma in an organisation. One methodology is DMAIC, which is used for bringing in quality improving existing processes of the business and the second methodology is DMADV, which is used at creating new products and processes of high quality. The success attained by the corporate houses like Motorola who pioneered six sigma lured the organisations all over the world from all spheres of activities to implement six sigma and attain the notable improvements in cost and quality. As a result, the organisations have taken the initiative to introduce six sigma training programs for their professionals to tune up their skill set.

Several institutions independently provide for six sigma courses against a fee which can be pursued by the professionals who wish to add to their portfolio and sharpen their skills. The six sigma certifications which can be obtained for various levels like yellow belt, green belt black belt, masters in black belt on the basis of the degree of specialisation.

After attaining the six sigma black belt training the professional becomes a technical expert who can effectively ensure proper implementation of projects involving six sigma. A certified black belt is the leader who is responsible at the ground level to give material shape to the quality aspirations of the top management for the organisation with the help of the lower cadre of six sigma certified professionals’ black belt certification gives the professionals an edge over their peers and provides them with the much desired education for quality improvement.

A comparatively recent improvement over six sigma is the lean six sigma which combines the concept of lean speed with that of six sigma and uses the methodology of DMAIC of six sigma in implementation. Lean speed focused on introducing remarkable improvement in the speed and efficiency of the processes in the organisation and thereby bringing about a substantial reduction in the total lead time. This, in turn, results in a significant reduction in cost to the organisation as the non-value adding steps in the processes are eliminated. Now the organisations have shifted their focus on lean six sigma training and lean six sigma certification courses which can deliver greater value on account of the synergistic benefits of six sigma and lean speed.

posts.title: Six Sigma Is Here For The Long Run
posts.bodyHtml:
Over the past few years, it has been debated by many professionals old and young about the ‘death’ of Six Sigma. Yet, the methodology and its fans just keep on growing. In fact, Lean Six Sigma has become so popular that it is now taught around the globe on a daily basis.

The truth is Six Sigma Training will never leave the business world.

Why?

Well, why would it? This is the one and only methodology which literally breeds perfection.

Indeed many individuals believe that the Six Sigma methodology isn’t right for their company. However, the masses disagree and more companies are implementing its techniques every single day.

But, how has Six Sigma lived through the recession? Why is it still here today?

Well, Six Sigma took its first breath when Motorola gave birth to it back in 1986 so has a great deal of experience in the ever-changing world of business as it has been around for a good few years. The whole point of Six Sigma was to create a brand new, innovative manufacturing process which would ultimately reduce any chance of finding any defects in any system in use. Moreover, over the year Lean Six Sigma has been named a ‘metric, methodology and management system’ which enables all control to be kept over each and every process no matter the size or stature of the company involved. Those individuals who have been on the Six Sigma Training Course and have gained the Six Sigma Certification are considered experts in the subject of Six Sigma. However, amongst these Six Sigma certified individuals lies a hidden hierarchy and this hierarchy is based upon the level of expertise in which the individual has. This hierarchy is determined by different coloured belts which change as the individual progresses throughout the Six Sigma Methodology.

These belts are as follows :

The Six Sigma Yellow Belt Training Course enables individuals to be a member of the Six Sigma team but unable to lead any such project. An individual with the yellow belt certification will usually be in charge of process mapping.

The Six Sigma Green Belt Training Course will teach individuals the development part of the Six Sigma methodology. This qualification will teach the professional how to be the leader of smaller projects and will, therefore, work primarily in project development.

The third stage is the Six Sigma Black Belt Training Course which ultimately teaches the professional to be the leader of the project. This course will help individuals have a clear understanding of everything to do with Six Sigma and how to execute each project efficiently.

There is also the Six Sigma Master Black Belt Training Course which enables the individual to be the coach and oversee each project whilst also coaching other members of the Six Sigma profession into developing their skills.

Lean Six Sigma has become so versatile over the years that many professionals are deciding to take the Six Sigma Course. The Six Sigma methodology often makes the headlines and therefore causes much of a stir amongst the professional field, causing more and more organisations to go in for the training course.

Lean Six Sigma is not just about learning heavy topics and having to remember the skills. But it is also about using the knowledge you already have in order to create a more efficient and ultimately successful business.

So, in short Lean Six Sigma is not going anywhere for a very long time, It is here to stay.

posts.bodyHtml:
‘Six Sigma’ is the phrase on everyone’s lips within the business sector, but very few are sure as to what it actually is and what it can do for the career of any professional.

Well, to put it short; Six Sigma is a quality measurement which is often put into place in order to create a near-perfect environment whereby there are zero amounts of quality defects present. Nowadays individuals, as well as customers, desire and strive for perfection and therefore it is vital that corporations find a practice which will enable this to be possible. This process is called Lean Six Sigma. To be honest, if you are a part of the business world you have probably heard about the necessity of Six Sigma, but I can guarantee that you fail to understand the importance it has and will have in your professional life in the future.

Let’s begin with the birth of Six Sigma…Motorola produced the process of Six Sigma which has now turned into the Lean Six Sigma Training Course. The general idea behind Six Sigma training is to ultimately eliminate defects by reducing the process variation which is currently in place. The Six Sigma process can be used in any department of any business due to its flexibility and high-performance value.

As I mentioned, the famous Six Sigma methodology has now turned into an award-winning training course which is now available across the UK. The training course has become so powerful that many corporations desire any new employee to have the Six Sigma Certification under their belt in the hope that they have learnt the skills and techniques which is taught throughout the teaching process. Moreover, during the training courses for Lean Six Sigma, there are several levels of expertise in the field in which you can gain throughout your Six Sigma journey.

These levels of expertise are described as ‘belts’.

The first level or belt is the Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt which will allow you to have the knowledge of working with Six Sigma on a daily basis under pressure. The next stage is; the Six Sigma Green Belt training which is often thought of as the first level of certification for Six Sigma and provides you with the basic teaching of the principles and methods of the Six Sigma methodology. The next step is to gain the Six Sigma Black Belt certification which will equip you with a great amount of knowledge regarding the process of this practice and will allow you to teach others about the methods which should and will be put into place. The final stage of the Six Sigma course is the Master Black Belt training course which is pretty much the top of the Lean Six Sigma career ladder. This is the highest level of education you can gain regarding the Six Sigma practices; putting this on your CV will force employers to want you as a part of their company. It is thought that the Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt training is one of the most powerful qualifications for any professional in the business environment.

Six Sigma is also often referred to by many as the business management system however, many also like to see it as a tool which helps create the perfect environment for any enterprise. Although this tool is not a problem solver it does stop problems from occurring in the first place.

So, in short, the only way forward in your career is to submit yourself to the Six Sigma Training Course which promotes success.
